message.content:
The title of “best player in soccer today” is highly debated and depends on the criteria you value—goals, assists, influence on the game, trophies, or overall skill. As of 2026, many consider **Lionel Messi** and **Kylian Mbappé** to be the top contenders:

| Player | Current Club | Position | Key Strengths | Recent Highlights |
|--------|--------------|----------|---------------|-------------------|
| **Lionel Messi** | Inter Miami (MLS) | Forward/Playmaker | Vision, dribbling, finishing, playmaking | 2025 MLS MVP, 2026 Copa América winner with Argentina |
| **Kylian Mbappé** | Paris Saint‑Germain | Forward | Speed, finishing, versatility, work rate | 2025 Ligue 1 top scorer, 2026 FIFA World Cup runner‑up |

Other strong candidates include **Erling Haaland** (Manchester City), **Kevin De Bruyne** (Manchester City), and **Neymar Jr.** (Al‑Ahli). Ultimately, the “best” player often comes down to personal preference and the specific metrics you prioritize.
